newsitem.title: UK: KBS rates Multibras "buy" after stellar show.
newsitem.headline: KBS rates Multibras "buy" after stellar show.

text.p: Kleinwort Benson Securities has reiterated a strong "buy" recommendation for Brazilian appliance-maker Multibras, upgrading its forecast EPS by 60 percent following recent spectacular growth.

"Considering above-average growth rates and excellent short and long-term prospects, Kleinwort Benson Securities expects the share price to reach R$2.30 over the next 12 months, thus recommending a strong Buy'," it said in a note to investors on Monday.
After what it described as the firm's stellar performance in the first half of 1996, KBS said it had upgraded its estimate for the company's earnings per share.
"First half of 1996 volume sales growth of 12 percent year on year, coupled with a doubling of operating profits, delivered R$103 in profits, a 76 percent jump over last year," it said.
"In the light of this stellar performance, Kleinwort Benson Securities has upgraded its EPS estimate by 60 percent... justifying a strong Buy' recommendation," it added.
Kleinwort Benson said it forecast earnings per share of R$0.19 for 1996, adding that the market's current consensus of R$0.14 was due for an upgrade.
Just over a week ago Credit Lyonnais Securities raised its earnings estimates for the firm to R$0.21 per share, and repeated its Buy' recommendation.
Multibras preferred shares closed at R$1.50 on the Sao Paulo bourse on Friday.
